stories.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro vão intensificar campanha por voto útil para tentar vencer no 1º turno

en.title: Datafolha: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will intensify campaign for strategic voting to try to win in first round
en.summary: The electoral committees of President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro plan to increase campaigns focused on strategic voting before the first round of elections on October 4th, with the race technically tied among main candidates.

stories.title: Aumento do Bolsa Família: quanto vou receber? Como medida chegou ao TSE? Veja perguntas e respostas

en.title: Bolsa Família increase: how much will I receive? How did the measure reach TSE? See questions and answers
en.summary: The Brazilian government announced a 15 percent increase in Bolsa Família minimum payments, raising it from R$600 to R$691, with average benefits expected to rise from R$675 to R$777.

stories.title: Libertadores tem semifinais definidas com Palmeiras x Fluminense e Flamengo x Estudiantes

en.title: Libertadores has semifinals defined with Palmeiras vs Fluminense and Flamengo vs Estudiantes
en.summary: Flamengo secured a 1-1 draw against Independiente del Valle with nine players on the field and advanced to the Copa Libertadores semifinals alongside Palmeiras, Fluminense, and Estudiantes.

stories.title: Flamengo busca empate com falha bizarra do goleiro do del Valle e vai à semifinal da Libertadores

en.title: Flamengo seeks draw with bizarre error by del Valle goalkeeper and advances to Libertadores semifinals
en.summary: Flamengo advanced to the Copa Libertadores semifinals after drawing with Independiente del Valle.

stories.title: 'Bolsonaro fez a mesma coisa; é o jogo das eleições', diz leitor sobre reajuste do Bolsa Família

en.title: 'Bolsonaro did the same thing; it's the election game', says reader about Bolsa Família adjustment
en.summary: A reader comments that former president Bolsonaro made similar adjustments to the Bolsa Família welfare program, characterizing such moves as typical election-year politics.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro desautoriza Zé Trovão por pedido contra aumento no Bolsa Família: ‘Não pedi isso’

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro disavows Zé Trovão over request against Bolsa Família increase: 'I didn't ask for this'
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro distances himself from Zé Trovão's request opposing an increase to the Bolsa Família program, denying he made such a request.

stories.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 60% entre beneficiários do Bolsa Família no segundo turno; Flávio tem 33%

en.title: Datafolha: Lula has 60% among Bolsa Família beneficiaries in runoff; Flávio has 33%
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows that Lula leads with 60% support among Bolsa Família beneficiaries in a runoff scenario, while Flávio receives 33% support.

stories.title: Flamengo x Independiente del Valle na Libertadores: onde assistir ao vivo, horário e escalação

en.title: Flamengo vs Independiente del Valle in Copa Libertadores: where to watch live, time and lineup
en.summary: Information is provided about the Flamengo versus Independiente del Valle Copa Libertadores match, including broadcast details, kickoff time, and team lineups.

stories.title: Mendonça rejeita ação contra reajuste do Bolsa Família

en.title: Mendonça rejects action against Bolsa Família increase
en.summary: A Brazilian electoral court minister rejected a lawsuit filed by a federal deputy candidate challenging the Bolsa Família benefit increase on procedural grounds without analyzing the case's merits.

stories.title: Do Bolsa Família às bets: Lula recorre a pacote de bondades na última hora para ‘segurar’ Flávio

en.title: From Bolsa Família to bets: Lula resorts to last-minute benefits package to 'hold' Flávio
en.summary: President Lula is reportedly using various benefit programs and policy measures as a last-minute effort to maintain political support from Flávio.

stories.title: Flamengo sofre, mas empata com o Del Valle e vai à semifinal da Libertadores

en.title: Flamengo suffers, but draws with Del Valle and advances to Libertadores semifinal
en.summary: Flamengo advanced to the Copa Libertadores semifinal despite a difficult match against Independiente del Valle.

stories.title: Flamengo empata com Del Valle (1-1) e vai à semifinal da Libertadores

en.title: Flamengo draws with Del Valle (1-1) and advances to Libertadores semifinal
en.summary: Flamengo drew 1-1 with Independiente del Valle and qualified for the Copa Libertadores semifinal.

stories.title: Na economia, com qual candidato a presidente você mais concorda?

en.title: In the economy, which presidential candidate do you agree with most?
en.summary: A news outlet offered readers an interactive test to identify which presidential candidate best aligned with their economic views.

stories.title: Ex-cunhado de Gilmar chamava Vorcaro de ‘irmão’ e recomendou aproximação com ministro do STF, diz O Globo

en.title: Ex-brother-in-law of Gilmar called Vorcaro 'brother' and recommended approach with STF minister, says O Globo
en.summary: Federal Police messages show banker Daniel Vorcaro was advised by businessman Chiquinho Feitosa, former brother-in-law of Supreme Court minister Gilmar Mendes, to approach the minister in April 2024. Feitosa presented himself as a bridge between Vorcaro and Mendes.

stories.title: Renan Santos entra com ação no TSE contra reajuste no Bolsa Família anunciado por Lula

en.title: Renan Santos files action at TSE against Bolsa Família adjustment announced by Lula
en.summary: Presidential candidate Renan Santos filed a lawsuit at the Electoral Superior Court challenging the 15.4 percent Bolsa Família increase announced by President Lula weeks before the election. The action requests minister André Mendonça as rapporteur.

stories.title: Brava confirma fim do processo de venda de ativos na Bacia Potiguar para consórcio

en.title: Brava confirms end of asset sale process in Potiguar Basin to consortium
en.summary: Brava Energia terminated its transaction to sell 11 onshore oil and gas concessions in Rio Grande do Norte to a consortium. The deal ended after the contractual deadline was reached without required conditions being satisfied by the buyer consortium.

stories.title: EZTec fecha contrato de locação do Esther Towers com Itaú

en.title: EZTec closes lease contract for Esther Towers with Itaú
en.summary: EZTec signed a comprehensive lease agreement for the Esther Towers corporate property in São Paulo with Itaú Unibanco, covering approximately 91,400 square meters. The contract has an initial ten-year term with a five-year renewal option.
